# Changing or cancelling an order

## Cancellation and changes
You can cancel an order or change the delivery address as long as it has not been dispatched. Write to our support team as soon as possible and mention your order number: orders are packed within a few hours on working days.
Once an order is dispatched it cannot be changed. In that case please refuse the delivery or use the 30-day return option.

## Wrong or missing items
If your parcel is incomplete or contains a wrong item, contact us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and a photo of the content. We send the missing item free of charge or refund it.

## Order confirmation
You receive an order confirmation by email within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
